Local detail-close callsites carry semantic marker; Side and unloaded/error thread fallback reuse official CloseButton.
Mobile CSS targets explicit detail-close/panel-back markers or native panel-action slot, not incidental SVG/span nesting.
Existing native mobile Side/thread X visibility retained; mobile uses back.
